name: Daniel Noboa
role: President of Ecuador (2023–present); Declared 'Internal Armed Conflict' Jan 2024, Re-elected April 2025
quote: We are at war, and we cannot cede in the face of these terrorist groups.

name: John Reimberg
role: Interior Minister (Feb 2025–present); Leads the Security Bloc Coordinating Police and Armed Forces
quote: Alias Gato Negro also tried to attempt against my life in my capacity as Interior Minister.

name: Gian Carlo Loffredo
role: Defense Minister; Announced $180 Million Security Equipment Investment
quote: Every dollar invested in equipment for our armed forces is a dollar invested in the security of Ecuadorian families.

name: Diana Salazar
role: Attorney General; Led the 'Metástasis' Judicial Corruption Prosecution
quote: This is the largest case in our history against corruption and drug trafficking.

name: Luisa González
role: Revolución Ciudadana Presidential Candidate; Lost 2025 Runoff to Noboa
quote: I denounce, before the people, before the media and the world, that Ecuador is living under a dictatorship. This is the biggest fraud in the history of Ecuador!

name: Rafael Correa
role: Exiled Former President (2007–2017); Revolución Ciudadana Movement Leader
quote: Militarizing the streets without addressing poverty and corruption only militarizes the crisis, not the solution.

name: José Adolfo 'Fito' Macías Villamar
role: Los Choneros Leader; Escaped Prison Jan 2024, Recaptured Jun 2025, Extradited to US Jul 2025
quote: I am innocent of the charges the United States government has brought against me.

name: Fabricio Colón Pico
role: Los Lobos Leader; Escaped Riobamba Prison Jan 9, 2024
quote: Los Lobos does not answer to Los Choneros or to the state.

name: Wilmer Geovanny Chavarría Barre, alias 'Pipo'
quote: We control what moves through these ports, not the government.

name: Galo Javier Suárez Román, alias 'Gato Negro'
role: Los Tiguerones Second-in-Command; Captured in Colombia, Linked to Plot Against Interior Minister
quote: They will not find me until I want to be found.

name: Marco Rubio
role: US Secretary of State; Designated Los Choneros and Los Lobos as Foreign Terrorist Organizations (Sep 2025)
quote: Los Choneros and Los Lobos have attacked and threatened public officials, judges, prosecutors, and journalists — their goal is to control drug trafficking routes through terror.

name: Kristi Noem
role: US Secretary of Homeland Security; Visited Ecuador Aug 2025 to Expand Security Cooperation
quote: The United States stands with Ecuador in the fight against the cartels poisoning our communities.

name: Juanita Goebertus
role: Americas Director, Human Rights Watch; Authored 'A Dangerous Partnership' Report (Jul 2026)
quote: US-Ecuador cooperation on security has been too opaque and too dangerous for Ecuadorians.

name: Wilman Terán
role: Former President, National Judicial Council; Sentenced 9 Years 4 Months in Metástasis Case (Nov 2025)
quote: I categorically deny having favored any criminal organization in my rulings.

name: UN Committee on Enforced Disappearances
role: Logged 51 Complaints of Alleged Enforced Disappearance by Ecuadorian Security Forces (2024–2025)
quote: States must ensure that measures to combat organized crime do not themselves become a source of enforced disappearance.

name: Gloria Alexandra Bravo Cedeño
role: Manabí Prosecutor; Investigated Organized Crime and Alleged US Drone Strikes on Fishing Boats; Assassinated Jun 14, 2026
quote: Neither my office nor the investigative police have the authority or the logistical means to investigate at sea.

name: Gen. Francis Donovan
role: Commander, US Southern Command (SOUTHCOM); Launched Western Hemisphere Joint Task Force, Deployed Warships & Special Forces to Ecuador Aug 2026
quote: Synchronize military capabilities and apply sustained pressure against the networks that threaten our collective security.
